data.name: Shub
data.gender_notes: Shub is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shub is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shubh' which means auspicious, well-being, prosperity, happiness, and good fortune. It is a popular name among Hindus and is believed to bring blessings and success in life. The name Shub carries the meaning “Well-being, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shub usually hope their child will grow to embody well-being, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shub is a spiritually significant name that symbolizes prosperity, happiness, and good fortune. It is believed to bring blessings and protection from the gods and is often used in religious and spiritual contexts.
data.etymology: Shub belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Well-being, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shub total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
